newsitem.title: JAPAN: Prosecutors deny arrest of former Nomura officials.
newsitem.headline: Prosecutors deny arrest of former Nomura officials.

text.p: Japanese state prosecutors on Wednesday denied local media reports that they had arrested three former Nomura Securities Co Ltd executives.
"We are very angry that the media falsely reported the arrest of the three persons without our formal announcement," Deputy District Chief Prosecutor Kunihiro Matsuo told a brief news conference.
"Even commonsense tells you that this kind of thing (these reports) should not be allowed," Matsuo said.
He refused to answer questions as to whether investigators were questioning the Nomura executives.
